designationHistory.name: Willapa Harbor Migratory Bird Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Willapa Harbor Migratory Bird Refuge by Executive Order 7541 on January 22, 1937.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Willapa National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
American Presidency Project: Executive Order 7541, Jan. 22, 1937, Establishing Willapa Harbor Migratory Bird Refuge
National Archives, Executive Orders Disposition Tables 1937: EO 7541, 2 FR 168

review.note: Year confirmed; exact date, EO and earlier name added.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Willapa National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1937 to protect migrating birds and their habitat at a time when many estuaries and shallow water bays were being destroyed in the name of progress.
